quotes.text: Get fast, secure transfers to your bank account, mobile wallet or a cash pickup location.
Support for business customers and recipients located in 170+ countries
Remitly’s global footprint reaches over 175 countries around the world, including United Kingdom, and is trusted by millions of people worldwide.
Remitly serves 175+ countries around the world.

Simply create your account on the Remitly app or at Remitly.com ⁠ (opens in new window) , enter the amount you'd like to send, and choose your recipient's preferred delivery method — whether that's a bank deposit, cash pickup, or others, depending on availability in the receiving country you’ve selected.
With Remitly, you can send money online from the United Kingdom directly to a bank account, with great rates and no hidden fees — and you'll see the full cost before you send.
Some eligible transfers may arrive within minutes, while others can take a few business days.
With Remitly, you get great rates, no hidden fees, and real-time transfer tracking—so you can know where your money is and when it will arrive.
